site.name: Enterprise Tech Provider
site.tagline: Stay ahead of what’s next to drive profitable growth
site.ownership: The Channel Company (publisher) — Dell Technologies (sponsor). A sponsored content destination for Dell partners (channel resellers / solution providers).

primary.displayedAs: white wordmark on dark teal band, ~200px wide

palette.where: header band, footer accents, h6 brand label, primary surface stripes; appears across all 5 pages
footer container; full-width dark band before footer
main content background on every page

paletteNotes: Palette is dominated by dark teal #003049 (Dell-adjacent) and pure white. No formal token set — see cssCustomProperties (only `--sa-uid` analytics token defined). All colors are hard-coded in the Drupal theme CSS.

type.fallbacks: Arial MT (Light/Narrow Light/Regular/Narrow Regular), Arial, sans-serif

scaleAudit.basis: Sizes do not follow a modular ratio. The semantic H1 on article pages is 25px and visually outranked by an unrelated H2 at 41px elsewhere on the same page. Headings use Roboto Condensed at multiple weights without a clear mapping from level to weight.

type.casing: Heavy ALL-CAPS — site nav, every section label on the home page (RECOMMENDED, ESSENTIAL READING, LATEST, NEWSLETTERS, …), and even article H1s on storage/newsroom templates. Title case is reserved for article card titles in card lists.

patterns: header co-branded band (publisher + sponsor) — repeats on every page
hero band: dark teal background + lifestyle stock photo + uppercase tagline — repeats on every page including author-profile and 404-prone utility pages
section label band: dark teal full-width strip with white uppercase H2 (RECOMMENDED, LATEST, etc.) — used 5–13 times on the home page
card grid: 309×309 thumbnail (rendered at 78–195px) + uppercase title link, no body summary, no metadata, no shadow, no border
right rail: ad slot 300×250 + newsletter signup form + ‘Newsletters’ promo
co-branded footer: dark band, two columns (Channel Co links, Dell links), social icons row, legal strip

samples.tagline: Stay ahead of what’s next to drive profitable growth
sampleHeadlines: How Dell Is Helping Partners Navigate an Unprecedented Memory Shortage
How Dell Is Accelerating Partners’ Success In The Era Of AI PC Computing
Why Dell’s PowerMaxOS 10.4 Enhancements Are Vital For Your Enterprise Customers’ Mission‑Critical Workloads
5 Ways Dell PowerProtect Helps You Grow Your Business By Protecting Your Customers

voice.register: B2B trade press, channel-partner audience. Direct-address (‘Help Your Customers…’, ‘Win…’, ‘Grow…’). Headline-driven — every card is a benefit promise to the reseller. Vocabulary is Dell-product-heavy (PowerStore, PowerMax, PoweEdge, AMD EPYC, vPro, NativeEdge, PowerProtect, AI Factory). Tone is earnest sponsored-content — no irony, no editorial voice, no opinion.

systemComponents.fingerprint: Dark teal band + 'PRODUCED BY THE CHANNEL COMPANY' + 'SPONSORED BY DELL TECHNOLOGIES' + (search bar + MENU button on right)
H1 'Enterprise Tech Provider' + H2 'Stay ahead of what’s next to drive profitable growth' + lifestyle stock photo of three people at a workstation
systemComponents.note: Repeats on every page including utility pages — costs the article ~190px of above-the-fold real estate before the title is ever shown.

systemComponents.fingerprint: Uppercase top-level nav: HOME · DELL TECHNOLOGIES ADVANTAGE · ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE · MODERN DATACENTER · STORAGE · MODERN WORKPLACE · IN PARTNERSHIP WITH INTEL (visible only after MENU click on most viewports)
Dark teal full-width band + uppercase H1 in white + image right; this is where the actual page title lives, after the global hero.
1440×900 iframe from cdn.privacy-mgmt.com — covers the entire viewport on first visit, blocking all content until dismissed.
300×250 GIF/JPEG ad + Newsletters form (3-field email-capture) + 'Newsletters' tile
Full-width dark teal strip with white uppercase H2 (e.g. ‘LATEST’, ‘POPULAR’) — used as a divider between card grids.
Repeated card: 309×309 thumbnail (rendered 78×195px) + 1–3 line title; no summary, no date, no author byline, no category chip.
Black band, 4 columns (ABOUT, CONTACT, CRN AWARDS, FOLLOW), social icons (Instagram/YouTube/X/LinkedIn), legal strip, TheChannelCo + Dell Technologies co-brand row.

tokens.tensionFlag: site ships zero design tokens — every color, font, spacing value is hard-coded inline or in legacy theme CSS

ageSignals: year-stamped image filenames suggest Photoshop pipeline
